I will also plant improved maize seed since I learned at school and from the extension worker that it performs better when paired with fertilizer. I will not use pesticides or irrigation because the rains are enough and those inputs cost too much for just 0.11 hectares. My family can handle the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, so I do not need to hire outside workers.
